description: Join a project that already exists, as a new team member. Run this instead of `setup` when someone else already set the project up — setup is for creating a project, and running it as a joiner writes scaffolding into a repo that already has it. `join` confirms which project you are bound to, shows the Active Decisions and canon docs you are expected to read, and shows the task pool you can claim from. It writes NOTHING to your repo. Does not call the Anthropic API.
name: join
